name: Cable Squat to Row
steps: Stand facing a waist-height pulley with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handle at arm's length.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees into a squat while keeping your arms extended forward.
Drive through your feet to stand upright while pulling the handle toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades briefly, then extend your arms forward as you lower into the next squat.
tips: Finish the row with your torso upright rather than leaning backward.
Keep your chest lifted and knees tracking over your toes during the squat.
